subject: LaunchPad discovery — POC objectives & next steps
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina@launchpad.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchPad discovery — POC objectives & next steps

Hi Lina / Sam —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the context on where LaunchPad is trying to get to. I wanted to capture the key pain points, proposed POC scope, and clear next steps so we have alignment before we schedule kickoff.

Quick summary of what I heard (please correct me if I missed anything):
- Pain: noisy categorization for user queries -> manual labeling backlog and unpredictable model costs under current infra.
- Goal: reduce manual triage by 60% for Tier-1 queries and lower per-token inference spend by ~30% in production.
- Constraints: PHI redaction required for a subset of data; SOC 2 evidence needed; pilot must run in us-west region.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks):
1) Data & access: redacted sample dataset (<= 200k tokens/day), S3 read-only + temporary service account.
2) Model & prompts: run three model variants (base, quantized, cached) against a 150-prompt eval set covering the top 20 intents.
3) Success metrics: triage reduction %, precision@3 for top intent, median p95 latency (target < 180ms), per-token cost delta.
4) Owners: Redwood AE (me) — engagement lead; Marissa — prompt/eval owner; Ben — infra & deployment owner; LaunchPad — data + compliance owner (Lina / Sam).
5) Deliverables: weekly syncs, prompt-eval dashboard, final recommendations with cost/latency tradeoffs.

Access checklist (what we'll need from you prior to kickoff):
- Redacted sample CSV (schema attached) or S3 path with read access.
- A short list of 10 "must-pass" intents for the initial eval.
- Contact for security questionnaire (SOC 2 point-of-contact).

Attachments: POC-SOW-v1.pdf (draft SOW), data-sample-schema.csv (schema stub).

Next steps I propose:
- Lina: confirm dataset availability and SOC 2 contact by EOD Wed (10/14).
- Redwood: finalize SOW -> I will send DocuSign draft by EOD Tue (10/13).
- Schedule kickoff: week of 10/19 — please share 2x 60-min windows that work.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Rachel — this captures the discussion well. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Data: we can provide a redacted sample in S3 (US-WEST) by Friday (10/16). It will be ~120k tokens/day equivalent.
- Compliance: SOC 2 contact is our security manager, Priya Mehta (priya.mehta@launchpad.ai). She’ll need the vendor questionnaire and an inventory of where logs are stored.
- Goals: the 60% triage reduction is aspirational; if we can hit 45% with no degradation in top-intent precision, that would be acceptable to the ops team.

One ask: can Redwood run a short baseline using our current model (we can provide model outputs for a slice) so we have an apples-to-apples comparison? If so, can Marissa own the eval rubric?

Proposed kickoff windows (PST):
- Tue 10/20, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 10/21, 11:00–12:00

If that works I’ll confirm with Priya and Sam. Looking forward to the plan.
